user.title: Add Halo Lite
user.description: Select a discovered Halo Lite device.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add Halo Lite
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? If you know the 4-character access code, enter it below. Otherwise leave it blank and power-cycle the Halo Lite (off/on) after adding so Home Assistant can capture it during the brief window after power-on.

reconfigure.title: Halo Lite access code
reconfigure.description: Enter the 4-character access code the Halo Lite accepts (for example TT84).

error.invalid_access_code: The access code must be exactly 4 printable characters.

abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported Halo Lite
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Halo Lite devices were found
abort.cannot_connect: The selected device could not be found
